parsed.summary: The PR aims to make AlterField a no-op for adding/changing choices on SQLite, but it introduces a non-minimal change by modifying the base schema and field classes.

issues.description: The PR modifies the base schema and field classes, which could have unintended side effects on other database backends and fields.
